= NIGHT SHIFT
= 
= A short screenplay made up for testing
= 

> FADE IN:

## INT. BAKERY - BACK ROOM - NIGHT

MARA HOLT, sixties, flour to the elbows, slides a tray into the oven. The bell over the door RINGS.

@MARA
We're closed.

@OSKAR (O.S.)
It's me.

OSKAR, twenties, soaked through, comes in with a paper bag. Inside it: a small brass KEY.

@MARA
(not looking up)
Where did you find that?

@OSKAR
Under the shed. Where you said.

A sign above the door reads NO ENTRY AFTER TEN.

> CUT TO BLACK.

= NIGHT SHIFT

## EXT. YARD - CONTINUOUS (ON THE MONITOR)

A grey picture of the yard, lit by one lamp. A GUARD walks past the gate.

@MARA (V.O.)
(in his ear)
Walk slowly. Keep to the wall.

@OSKAR
I am walking slowly.

@MARA (V.O.)
Now left.

A dog BARKS somewhere.

## INT. BAKERY - FRONT ROOM - LATER

The lamp goes out. BLACK. Then the oven light, orange, low.

@MARA
(beat)
Keep it.
(beat)
Keep it safe.

> FADE OUT.

= THE END
